_schema.description: GATE G2 — THE OWNER FILLS THIS IN. Read clusters.json. Each row there is a search-intent page; decide which pages the new site launches with and each page's default preset (shape, background, starter text). Old Shopify URLs 301 to their page (listing-map.json pageKey), or to whatever redirectTo names when a page is not built. Nothing builds the site catalog until this file is filled. Do not generate it automatically.

row.presetFrom: etsyListingId whose photo and wording seed the page, usually clusters.json suggestedPreset
row.redirectTo: pageKey that takes this page's old URLs when build is false
